definitions.explanation: Cancer of the pancreas ({膵臓|すいぞう}). Known for being difficult to detect early and for having a poor prognosis. The second element is often written in kana as {膵臓|すいぞう}がん.

examples.japanese: {膵臓癌|すいぞうがん}は{発見|はっけん}が{難|むずか}しい。
examples.english: Pancreatic cancer is hard to detect.

examples.japanese: {祖父|そふ}は{膵臓癌|すいぞうがん}で{亡|な}くなった。
examples.english: My grandfather died of pancreatic cancer.

examples.japanese: {膵臓癌|すいぞうがん}は{初期|しょき}{症状|しょうじょう}が{少|すく}なく、{見|み}つかったときには{進行|しんこう}していることが{多|おお}い。
examples.english: Pancreatic cancer has few early symptoms and is often already advanced by the time it is found.

notes:
Cancer of the pancreas, notorious for late detection and a difficult prognosis. The second element is frequently written in kana: {膵臓|すいぞう}がん.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {膵臓癌|すいぞうがん}を{患|わずら}う: to suffer from pancreatic cancer
- {膵臓癌|すいぞうがん}の{手術|しゅじゅつ}: surgery for pancreatic cancer
- {早期発見|そうきはっけん}: early detection
